lines: The longing one thereby gains the guru's knowledge-initiation — by it at once freed, even living here.
Its kinds: seeing, telling, scripture-teaching, conduct-showing, charity-giving, and the rest.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yiyāsuḥ guroḥ jñānalakṣaṇāṃ dīkṣāṃ prāpnoti yayā sadya eva mukto bhavati jīvann api atra avalokanāt kathanāt śāstrasambodhanāt caryādarśanāt carudānāt ityādayo bhedāḥ
